audit_events_actor_id_present.name: audit_events_actor_id_present
audit_events_actor_id_present.value: actor_type = 'system' OR actor_id IS NOT NULL

auth_accounts_no_credentials.name: auth_accounts_no_credentials
auth_accounts_no_credentials.value: access_token IS NULL AND refresh_token IS NULL AND id_token IS NULL AND password IS NULL

checkout_claims_consumed_after_creation.name: checkout_claims_consumed_after_creation
checkout_claims_consumed_after_creation.value: consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at

claim_requests_email_envelope_json.name: claim_requests_email_envelope_json
claim_requests_email_envelope_json.value: email_envelope IS NULL OR (json_valid(email_envelope) AND json_type(email_envelope) = 'object')

claim_requests_processed_erased.name: claim_requests_processed_erased
claim_requests_processed_erased.value: processed_at IS NULL OR email_envelope IS NULL

claim_requests_processed_after_creation.name: claim_requests_processed_after_creation
claim_requests_processed_after_creation.value: processed_at IS NULL OR processed_at >= created_at

claim_tokens_consumed_after_creation.name: claim_tokens_consumed_after_creation
claim_tokens_consumed_after_creation.value: consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at

connection_intents_consumed_in_window.name: connection_intents_consumed_in_window
connection_intents_consumed_in_window.value: consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at

entitlements_interval_valid.name: entitlements_interval_valid
entitlements_interval_valid.value: valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > valid_from

grants_retry_class_valid.name: grants_retry_class_valid
grants_retry_class_valid.value: retry_class IS NULL OR retry_class IN ('retryable', 'rate_limited', 'user_action_required', 'terminal')

grants_error_classified.name: grants_error_classified
grants_error_classified.value: (state = 'error') = (last_error_code IS NOT NULL AND retry_class IS NOT NULL)

paddle_connections_api_key_envelope_json.name: paddle_connections_api_key_envelope_json
paddle_connections_api_key_envelope_json.value: api_key_envelope IS NULL OR (json_valid(api_key_envelope) AND json_type(api_key_envelope) = 'object')

paddle_connections_webhook_secret_envelo.name: paddle_connections_webhook_secret_envelope_json
paddle_connections_webhook_secret_envelo.value: webhook_secret_envelope IS NULL OR (json_valid(webhook_secret_envelope) AND json_type(webhook_secret_envelope) = 'object')

paddle_connections_live_has_credentials.name: paddle_connections_live_has_credentials
paddle_connections_live_has_credentials.value: status = 'disconnected' OR ((credential_kind <> 'api_key' OR api_key_envelope IS NOT NULL) AND destination_id IS NOT NULL AND webhook_secret_envelope IS NOT NULL)

paddle_connections_disconnected_erased.name: paddle_connections_disconnected_erased
paddle_connections_disconnected_erased.value: status <> 'disconnected' OR (api_key_envelope IS NULL AND webhook_secret_envelope IS NULL)

paddle_prices_billing_cycle_valid.name: paddle_prices_billing_cycle_valid
paddle_prices_billing_cycle_valid.value: (billing_interval IS NULL AND billing_frequency IS NULL) OR (billing_interval IS NOT NULL AND billing_frequency IS NOT NULL AND billing_interval IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year') AND billing_frequency >= 1)

provider_mutations_retry_class_valid.name: provider_mutations_retry_class_valid
provider_mutations_retry_class_valid.value: retry_class IS NULL OR retry_class IN ('retryable', 'rate_limited', 'user_action_required', 'terminal')

provider_mutations_failure_classified.name: provider_mutations_failure_classified
provider_mutations_failure_classified.value: (status = 'failed') = (error_code IS NOT NULL AND retry_class IS NOT NULL)

provider_mutations_finished.name: provider_mutations_finished
provider_mutations_finished.value: (status = 'started') = (finished_at IS NULL) AND (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at)

subscriptions_period_valid.name: subscriptions_period_valid
subscriptions_period_valid.value: current_period_start IS NULL OR current_period_end IS NULL OR current_period_end > current_period_start

workspaces_slug_format.name: workspaces_slug_format
workspaces_slug_format.value: length(slug) BETWEEN 3 AND 48 AND slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND slug NOT GLOB '-*' AND slug NOT GLOB '*-' AND slug NOT GLOB '*--*'

workspaces_name_format.name: workspaces_name_format
workspaces_name_format.value: length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND name = trim(name, ' ' || char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13))
